instructions:
1. Yank billing-api into register a ("ayE) and 9090 into the unnamed register (yE).

3. Fill in the blanks from insert mode with Ctrl-r: 9090 after localhost: (Ctrl-r "), billing-api after name = (Ctrl-r a), and 300 after timeout_seconds = (Ctrl-r =60*5).
